name: Ricardo Flores
bio:
Ricardo Flores's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during a family trip to a local race when he was a teenager. The roar of the engines and the palpable tension in the air ignited a passion within him. Prior to joining Meyer Shank Racing, Ricardo spent two decades honing his skills in corporate security, eventually leading security operations for a major logistics firm. His experience translates into meticulous planning and risk assessment, ensuring the safety of the team's assets and personnel.

Ricardo's approach as a security chief is proactive and comprehensive. He believes in staying one step ahead, utilizing advanced technology and strategic thinking to anticipate and mitigate potential threats. He's also a firm believer in fostering a culture of security awareness within the team, ensuring everyone understands their role in maintaining a safe environment. What distinguishes Ricardo is his ability to blend his corporate security expertise with an understanding of the unique demands of the motorsport world. He's not just a security professional; he's a member of the team dedicated to their collective success.

physical.description: Ricardo is a stocky man with a weathered face and a commanding presence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of pacing while on the phone, even in small spaces.
Insists on personally checking every door and lock at the end of the day.
